en.content: Choose the correct representation of conductometric titration of benzoic acid vs sodium hydroxide.
en.explanation:
(A) (B) Free ions are replaced by which decreases conductance.

(B) (C) Un-dissociated benzoic acid reacts with and forms salt which increases ions & conductance increases.

(C) (D) After equivalence point at (3), added further increases ions which further increases the conductance.
